claude.sample_unit: FDA drug safety communications and medication guides

links.outcome: Reading grade level of original FDA DSCs and medication guides
links.effect: Original materials were difficult to read (DSCs grade level 13, MGs 22).
links.quote: Original materials were difficult to read (DSCs grade level 13, MGs 22).

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-simplified materials versus originals, with technical accuracy retained
links.effect: LLMs reduced grade levels (single prompt DSCs: ChatGPT 10.1, Gemini 8; MGs: ChatGPT 7.1, Gemini 6.5); outputs retained technical accuracy and key messages.
links.quote: LLMs significantly improved readability, reducing the grade levels to more accessible readings (Single prompt - DSCs: ChatGPT 4.0© 10.1, Gemini© 8; MGs: ChatGPT 4.0© 7.1, Gemini© 6.5.

openai.sample_unit: drug safety communications and medication guides

links.outcome: Reading grade level of original materials
links.quote: Original materials were difficult to read (DSCs grade level 13, MGs 22).

links.outcome: Readability grade level of LLM outputs
links.effect: Single prompt: DSCs 10.1/8, MGs 7.1/6.5; multiple prompts: DSCs 10.3/7.5, MGs 8/6.8.
links.quote: LLMs significantly improved readability, reducing the grade levels to more accessible readings (Single prompt - DSCs: ChatGPT 4.0© 10.1, Gemini© 8; MGs: ChatGPT 4.0© 7.1, Gemini© 6.5. Multiple prompts - DSCs: ChatGPT 4.0© 10.3, Gemini© 7.5; MGs: ChatGPT 4.0© 8, Gemini© 6.8).

links.outcome: Technical accuracy and key message retention
links.effect: Outputs retained technical accuracy and key messages; no numeric accuracy values reported.
links.quote: LLM outputs retained technical accuracy and key messages.

unlisted_practices: Using single versus multiple prompts to simplify FDA patient communications

links.outcome: Readability grade level of patient communications
links.effect: Original materials were grade 13 (DSCs) and 22 (MGs); LLMs reduced grade levels to 7.5-10.3 for DSCs and 6.5-8 for MGs across prompting strategies, retaining technical accuracy.
links.quote: LLMs significantly improved readability, reducing the grade levels to more accessible readings (Single prompt - DSCs: ChatGPT 4.0© 10.1, Gemini© 8; MGs: ChatGPT 4.0© 7.1, Gemini© 6.5. Multiple prompts - DSCs: ChatGPT 4.0© 10.3, Gemini© 7.5; MGs: ChatGPT 4.0© 8, Gemini© 6.8).
